meta.title: Internal build
meta.description: Wringy internal build: data read from the database through the API.

banner: 内部版本 · Internal build · Versi dalaman

page.title: Internal build
page.description: This page shows demonstration campaigns read from the database through the API, and the health of the background jobs.

campaigns.title: Demonstration campaigns
campaigns.description: Fixture campaigns read from the database through the API, with the API's read-only account.
campaigns.caption: Demonstration campaigns in the database, most recently updated first
campaigns.emptyDescription: The database holds no fixture campaigns. An operator loads them with pnpm db:seed:fixtures.

workers.title: Background job health
workers.description: Each background worker reports a process heartbeat and a queue round trip. Both are judged on the database clock.
workers.noneDescription: No background worker has written a heartbeat to this database, so its state is unknown. Unknown does not mean zero.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: There is no internal-build page at this address.

notConfigured.title: API not configured
notConfigured.description: The web server has no usable API address, so nothing is read. An operator sets the variables below and restarts it.

apiUnreachable.title: The API could not be reached
apiUnreachable.description: The web server got no answer from the API in time, so nothing is shown. Nothing was changed.

apiUnavailable.title: The database is unavailable
apiUnavailable.description: The API is running but cannot read its database right now, so nothing is shown. Nothing was changed.

unexpected.title: Unexpected answer from the API
unexpected.description: The API answered in a way this page does not recognise, so nothing is shown. Nothing was changed.
